name: Bendazac

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Spain, first in 1993 — for liver harm

summary: Bendazac was pulled from the market in Spain, beginning in 1993, due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, calculated a medium score of 60 for liver risk [M]. That same computer model also produced a low score of 22 for heart risk [M].
